title: PhpTourney
wikitext:
phpTourney is a widely flexible and easy to set up script collection for first-person shooter online tournaments.

== About ==
* First release: 20th of March, [[2006]] by [[Image:flag_de.gif]] [[Eb]]
* Current version: phpTourney-0.8.8
* Official website: [http://subdevice.org/phpTourney/ http://subdevice.org/phpTourney/]

== Features ==
* Single- and Double-Elimination brackets with optional Qualifier.
* Supports cropping screenshots in the browser (ImageMagick required).
* TCL eggdrop script included for posting results and news-posts in IRC.

== phpTourney in action ==
